// Create RetailSalesEvents table

.create table RetailSalesEvents (
    EventID: string,
    OrderLineID: string,
    OrderID: string,
    EventTime: datetime,
    CustomerID: string,
    ProductID: string,
    ProductName: string,
    CategoryName: string,
    Quantity: int,
    UnitPrice: real,
    DiscountRate: real,
    NetAmount: real
)

// Verify the schema
.show table RetailSalesEvents cslschema

// Configure retention policy
.alter-merge table RetailSalesEvents policy retention softdelete = 30d recoverability = enabled

.show table RetailSalesEvents policy retention


// // 5 min real-time sales aggregation. Analyze revenue, unique orders, and units sold during the last 24 hours.
RetailSalesEvents
| where EventTime > ago(24h)
| summarize
    Revenue = sum(NetAmount),
    Orders = dcount(OrderID),
    UnitsSold = sum(Quantity)
    by bin(EventTime, 5m)
| order by EventTime asc



//Inspect latest POS events
RetailSalesEvents
| order by EventTime desc
| project EventID, OrderLineID, OrderID, EventTime, ProductName, Quantity, UnitPrice, NetAmount
| take 10
